The '''Missile Boat combat medallion''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] medal awarded for completing basic training with [[Missile Boat]]s. It had an engraving of an Imperial Missile Boat.

There were three versions of the medal, which differed only in the metal used to create it: [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]], [[Silver/Legends|silver]], and [[Gold/Legends|gold]]. The bronze version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the Missile Boat's dual weapons systems and its onboard anti-warhead defensive measures. The silver version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the above as well as a reenactment of a mine-clearing operation. The gold version was presented to pilots who completed the above training operations as well as a mock dogfight against a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]].

==Known recipients==
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] received all three versions of this medal after completing the training ops relating to the Missile Boat during the fight against [[Demetrius Zaarin]].
